_disabled._note: DISABLED: `make lint` on `git commit`. Blocks commits in projects without a Makefile/`lint` target. To re-enable, move this object (without `_note`) into `hooks.PreToolUse`.

hooks.command: if make -n fmt >/dev/null 2>&1; then make fmt; fi
targets=$(for t in test lint; do make -n "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf " %s" "$t"; done); if [ -n "$targets" ]; then echo "Reminder: run make$targets before considering work complete"; fi
